2608.06223.title: TS-RAG: Retrieval Augmented Generation for Time Series Forecasting
2608.06223.paper_summary: While deep learning models, particularly transformer-based architectures, have shown impressive performance in time series forecasting, the application of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in this domain remains limited. Since RAG has proven effective in enhancing the capabilities of large language models by incorporating relevant external information, retrieving similar time series sequences as references might also improve accuracy in time series forecasting tasks. However, most time series models are constrained by limited training data, smaller parameter scales, and a lack of the extensive generative capabilities found in large language models. Simply concatenating reference sequences into the prompt, as done in language models, may not yield the expected results. To address these challenges, we propose a novel approach, TS-RAG, which leverages RAG to enhance forecasting performance. The framework introduces specially designed reference tokens to effectively fuse information from the input sequence with that from retrieved similar sequences, enabling a more robust capture of complex temporal dynamics. Experimental results demonstrate that TS-RAG achieves consistent state-of-the-art performance across several real-world forecasting benchmarks.
2608.06223.paper_summary_zh: 雖然深度學習模型，特別是基於Transformer的架構，在時間序列預測中顯示出令人印象深刻的表現，但檢索增強生成（RAG）在這一領域的應用仍然有限。由於RAG已被證明能通過整合相關的外部信息來增強大型語言模型的能力，檢索相似的時間序列作為參考也可能提高時間序列預測任務的準確性。然而，大多數時間序列模型受到有限訓練數據、小型參數規模以及缺乏大型語言模型中廣泛生成能力的限制。僅僅將參考序列串聯到提示中，如同在語言模型中所做的，可能無法產生預期的結果。為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了一種新穎的方法，TS-RAG，利用RAG來增強預測性能。該框架引入了專門設計的參考標記，以有效地融合來自輸入序列的信息與來自檢索到的相似序列的信息，使得能夠更穩健地捕捉複雜的時間動態。實驗結果表明，TS-RAG在幾個現實世界的預測基準上達到了持續的最先進性能。
